summaryEvents.text: The connector is clear of the socket, and force baselines are calibrated. The side view guides the approach.
The connector remains slightly off center. Small corrections continue near the socket face.
The contact estimate is revised. The connector withdraws before the tip and opening are checked in both wrist views.
The side view shows the tip is too high. Measured motion is smaller than commanded, so each correction is checked.
Both wrist views show the tip occupying the opening. Controlled insertion begins with repeated alignment checks.
The connector has advanced and remains engaged. A small rotation reduces bending before release and final seating.
